customSections.label: How PBCSD Organizes the School Year
customSections.content: PBCSD uses different grading periods for elementary and secondary schools. Teacher workdays are no-school days for students, and emergency make-up dates are not fixed in advance.

table.caption: PBCSD 2026–27 grading periods, teacher workdays, and emergency make-up guidance
rows: Elementary schools use three trimesters: August 10–November 2, November 4–February 12, and February 16–May 27.
Secondary schools use four quarters: August 10–October 9, October 13–December 18, January 5–March 19, and March 30–May 27.
The first semester runs August 10–December 18. The second runs January 5–May 27.
Teacher work days / professional development days
Students do not attend October 12, November 3, January 4, February 15, March 29, or May 28.
The Superintendent may schedule make-up days when additional instructional time is required under state law. Check official district notices after an emergency closure.

customSections.label: About This Calendar
customSections.content: The School District of Palm Beach County serves public school students across Palm Beach County, including West Palm Beach, Boca Raton, Wellington, Jupiter, and Belle Glade. This page covers districtwide dates on the current official 2026–27 calendar. Individual schools may publish additional dates for testing, events, early dismissal, or program-specific schedules.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2025–26
content: The first student day moves from August 11 to August 10.
Spring Break moves from March 16–20 to March 22–26.
The last student day moves from May 29 to May 27.

calendarFaqs.q: When does school start in Palm Beach County in 2026–2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school is Monday, August 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school in Palm Beach County in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Thursday, May 27, 2027. May 28 is a teacher workday when students do not attend.

calendarFaqs.q: When is PBCSD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break is March 22–26, 2027. March 29 is a no-school day for students, so classes resume Tuesday, March 30.

calendarFaqs.q: When is PBCSD Winter Break in 2026–2027?
When do PBCSD students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: January 4 is a no-school day for students, so classes resume Tuesday, January 5, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Are PBCSD teacher workdays school days for students?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Students do not attend on the districtwide teacher workdays listed on this page.

calendarFaqs.q: Can emergency closures change the PBCSD calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. PBCSD states that emergency make-up days are scheduled at the Superintendent’s discretion when additional instructional time is required. Check district notices after a closure.

calendarFaqs.q: Does every PBCSD school follow exactly the same calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Districtwide dates apply broadly, but individual schools and programs may publish additional testing, early-dismissal, event, or program-specific dates.

sourceReviewSummary: This page was checked against PBCSD’s current amended 2026–27 calendar PDF and official Key Dates page on August 7, 2026.
sourceReviewDetails: We verified the first and last student days, holidays, teacher workdays, major breaks, return dates, grading periods, and emergency make-up guidance.
The current amended PDF lists three elementary trimesters and four secondary quarters grouped into two semesters.

Source precedence: When PBCSD’s Key Dates page conflicts with the current amended calendar PDF, MySchoolDates follows the current amended PDF for calendar dates and labels. At our August 7, 2026 review, PBCSD’s Key Dates page contained several discrepancies in dates, labels, and attendance-day counts. We do not publish attendance-day totals where the official sources disagree.
PBCSD states that emergency make-up days are scheduled at the Superintendent’s discretion in accordance with state instructional-time requirements.
The 2025–26 and 2026–27 official calendars were used for the year-over-year comparison.
The downloadable ICS file is generated from the dates listed on this page and does not update automatically if PBCSD revises its calendar.
